parameters.subject: Emergency: Need your attention - SolarLive login failed
parameters.message: =SolarLive monitoring could not sign in (HTTP status {{ $json.httpStatus }}). Automatic checks did not run. Please check the SolarLive username and password saved in the n8n workflow "SolarLive Monitor".

parameters.content:
## Before first run
1. In "Login Details" enter the SolarLive username and password.
2. In "Log Daily Row" pick the Google Sheet. It needs one tab per plant named Agastya, Dhanpura-Magriwada and Nimbaj, with these headers in row 1: Date, Plant, Generation_kWh, CUF_pct, Tariff, Expected_Earnings_INR, SolarLive_Revenue_INR, Inverter_kWh, Open_Alerts, MTD_kWh.
3. Check the workflow timezone is Asia/Kolkata.
4. Tariffs and recipients are at the top of the "Assemble Report" code.
